_comment: Drift pins for scripts/capture_availability.py. A source whose observed shape leaves the pinned range raises an alarm and fails the build (override with ALLOW_DRIFT=1, which is recorded in the ledger). Ranges are set from the first verified capture on 2026-11-18 and must be reviewed, not widened silently.

known_zero.depth_HOU: Houston publishes the depth chart as an image (houstontexans.com/team/depth-chart, read 2026-11-18: 'Unofficial Depth Chart' image, no machine-readable rows). Documented property of the publisher; flagged F-DEPTH-HOU, not a parser regression.
